scope: Theorem 6.9 (Actual irregular-disk decay with end caps) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 78. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are c, C > 0, depending only on the fixed model, such that in the disks of Convention 6.1, P(actual I-to-J path) ≤ C  1 + r R c . The bound is uniform under any planar noncrossing partition on the two end intervals, including a joint partition across the ends, provided there are no other ties. Thus a joint end cap may identify slots of I with slots of J, but it contains no longitudinal-flank slots outside those end intervals.
